feed.title: Globe, Smart, PLDT to block sites streaming school shootings, violent content
feed.summary: Telecommunications companies Globe Telecom, PLDT Inc., and Smart Communications Inc. have announced they will block websites that host or stream content depicting school shootings and other violent acts. feed.title: Kroger’s $17 million settlement could benefit shoppers: Find out if you will receive a cash payout from the supermarket chain
feed.summary: Kroger has agreed to a $17 million settlement in a class-action lawsuit alleging inflated prescription drug prices for customers using insurance benefits. Eligible pharmacy customers who purchased prescription drugs from Kroger between December 9, 2018, and August 23, 2026, using their insurance, may be entitled to a payout. Claimants have until December 21, 2026, to file their claim either by mail or online.
